acquisition_method: Higher energy collisional dissociation fragmentation was performed for the top-10 peaks in each MS scan.
alkylation_reagent: FASP procedure included the following steps: SDS buffer replacement with 8M urea buffer, protein alkylation with iodoacetamide and replacement of urea buffer with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate.
cleavage_agent: Equal protein amounts of the super-SILAC mix and each of the tissue samples were combined and trypsin digested using the FASP protocol.
fractionation_method: We fractionated the peptides of each of the samples into six fractions by strong anion exchange chromatography in a StageTip format as described previously.
fragmentation_method: Higher energy collisional dissociation fragmentation was performed for the top-10 peaks in each MS scan.
ionization_type: HPLC was coupled online via a nano-electrospray ion source to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: HCC1599, HCC2218 and HCC1937 cells were SILAC-labelled by culturing them in RPMI in which the natural lysine and arginine were replaced by Lys-8 and Arg-10 and supplemented with 10% dialyzed serum and antibiotics.
mass_analyzer: inferred: HPLC was coupled online via a nano-electrospray ion source to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
reduction_concentration: After removal of ethanol, samples were vacuum-dried and resuspended in lysis buffer containing 100 mM Tris HCl pH 7.5, 4% SDS and 100 mM DTT.
reduction_reagent: After removal of ethanol, samples were vacuum-dried and resuspended in lysis buffer containing 100 mM Tris HCl pH 7.5, 4% SDS and 100 mM DTT.

ptm.evidence: MS/MS spectra were searched in the Andromeda search engine against the forward and reverse Human Uniprot database including the variable modifications methionine oxidation and N-terminal acetylation, and the fixed modification of carbamidomethyl cysteine.
